info.title: ControlServer.FakeMesIngest
info.description: A test double for the parts of MesIngest V2 the WIRE_TO_GATE runtime reads. Two surfaces on one listener: the MesIngest data plane ControlServer polls, and a loopback control plane a scenario drives. It stands in for three endpoints, not for MesIngest.

get.description: ControlServer compares contractVersion, schemaVersion and the whole capability set exactly, and refuses to read the catalog unless all three match. PUT /control/v1/contract with breakContract=true makes this answer a version it rejects.

get.summary: MesIngest data plane: the open demand catalog.
get.description: The response carries a weak ETag derived from the body (W/"catalog-h{historyEpoch:N}-r{catalogRevision}"). ControlServer recomputes it and refuses a catalog whose identity does not match, so the header is part of the contract. Demand ids are unique and ordinally sorted for the same reason.

200.description: Catalog body with contractVersion, historyEpoch, catalogRevision, count and items.

get.description: observedAt is stamped at request time: unlike the session-scoped Onboard snapshots, ControlServer ages this one out against MaximumEvidenceAge.

get.summary: Control plane: liveness and the current demand count.
Control plane: catalog identity and every demand in it.

post.summary: Control plane: start a new round at revision 1 with an empty catalog.

put.summary: Control plane: add or replace one demand.
put.description: Fields not given keep their current value, or take a sensible default on first insert. sublot, area, eqp and package have no default and must be supplied once. Any change bumps catalogRevision.

parameters.name: demandId
parameters.description: MesIngest reports these unhyphenated; ControlServer normalises them on the way in, so send the unhyphenated form to keep covering that.

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT (a required field was never supplied, or maxBoxCount <= 0).

delete.summary: Control plane: remove one demand from the catalog.

200.description: Accepted, replayed, or changed=false when it was not there.

put.summary: Control plane: make contract discovery answer a version ControlServer rejects.

area.description: Must be an area code parsed out of a station name, not a prefix of one: MapStationResolver splits "N1-3_N1-7" into N1-3 and N1-7, and "N1" matches neither.
